text:
mira: FYI I'm bringing up marmot-small-embed-v2 (trained fp16) with int8 per-channel quantization on the multilingual holdout. Quick sanity shows recall@1 on en/wiki dropped from 0.692 -> 0.654. creating a triage thread.

rahul: can you paste the eval command + the full metrics dump?

mira: sure — running the standard holdout sweep (k=1,5,10) across en/es/fr/zh. command and raw output below:
```
# eval command
python eval/holdout.py --model marmot-small-embed-v2 --quant int8-perchannel --holdout sets/multilang_k10.json --batch 256 --seed 42

# summarized output (recall@1/5/10, silhouette)
en: r@1=0.654 r@5=0.812 r@10=0.868 silhouette=0.21
es: r@1=0.602 r@5=0.775 r@10=0.841 silhouette=0.19
fr: r@1=0.618 r@5=0.788 r@10=0.847 silhouette=0.20
zh: r@1=0.581 r@5=0.743 r@10=0.802 silhouette=0.16

baseline (fp16) en: r@1=0.692 r@5=0.833 r@10=0.886 silhouette=0.24
``` 
(also cluster counts looked stable: ~12.5k clusters)

jon: batch=256 ok. tokenization pipeline identical to baseline right? no added preproc changes?

mira: tokenization identical. micro-batching and pooling identical. only change is quantizer: per-channel symmetric int8 with static range estimated from calibration set of 10k samples.

keisha: do we have a couple of concrete query examples where top-1 flips? paste one or two "before vs after" NN lists so we can inspect semantic drift.

mira: pasted two quick cases (query, top-3 baseline -> top-3 quantized):
```
Q: "how to rotate an image 90 degrees in python"
baseline top3: ["PIL.Image.rotate doc", "numpy rot90 snippet", "stack overflow: rotate image"]
quant top3: ["PIL.Image.transpose usage", "PIL.Image.rotate doc", "numpy rot90 snippet"]
-- small shuffle, still OK

Q: "symptoms of hypothyroidism"
baseline top3: ["hypothyroidism overview (clin med)", "labs: tsh/t4 guidance", "patient symptom list"]
quant top3: ["labs: tsh/t4 guidance", "hypothyroidism overview (clin med)", "case report: hypothyroid presentation"]
-- notice swap: relevance score reduced for the overview page
```

eval-bot: evaluation-run 1733334444 completed: 4 langs, 10k holdout, config=int8-perchannel, artifact s3://evals/marmot/1733334444/report.html

rahul: hypothesis: per-channel symmetric clamp may be clipping tail features causing slight angular distortion. try per-channel asymmetric calibration (min/max) or FAISS quant-rescale trick. also run a per-tensor baseline to see if per-channel is the offender.

jon: also try applying l2 normalization post-quant (cosine rescale) — a lot of recall regressions are recovered by re-normalizing outputs after low-bit quant.

mira: launching 3 quick jobs now: (A) per-channel asymmetric, (B) per-tensor int8, (C) per-channel symmetric + post-L2 norm. using same seed and holdout. ETA ~45m. will post results here.

keisha: if (A)-(C) don't recover, fallback plan: mixed-precision routing (keep en/fr fp16, int8 for low-resource) or add per-layer outlier clipping before quant. please include silhouette and sample NN diffs in the new runs.

mira: noted and filed PR #1482 to add per-language precision policy + eval dashboard hooks. assigning jon to perf-run and rahul to quant-config review.

jon: ack — will check perf/throughput impact if we do mixed per-lang shards.

(45 minutes pass)

mira: quick follow-up results:
```
A: per-channel asymmetric => en r@1=0.671 r@5=0.823 r@10=0.877 silhouette=0.225
B: per-tensor int8 => en r@1=0.639 r@5=0.798 r@10=0.854 silhouette=0.202
C: per-channel symmetric + L2norm => en r@1=0.678 r@5=0.828 r@10=0.881 silhouette=0.22

multilang summary (r@1): A: [en=0.671,es=0.619,fr=0.633,zh=0.604]
C: [en=0.678,es=0.622,fr=0.637,zh=0.609]
baseline fp16 en=0.692
```
C (post-L2) recovers most of the gap but not all. per-tensor is worse. per-channel asymmetric helps too.

rahul: nice — looks like post-quant normalization is the easiest win. cost delta is minimal. can we add a cheap per-request L2 normalize in the runtime as a temporary config flag? fallback route if a rollout shows drift.

mira: creating runtime flag now and a canary with C config. I'll schedule a small canary rollout to 5% traffic for next deploy window.

keisha: make sure to add a test that checks top-1 churn percentile on a fixed probe set before granting rollout.

mira: adding that to PR. will post canary metrics here after traffic runs. thanks all for quick triage :slightly_smiling_face:
